titulo: The genitive: possession, time and wegen, während, trotz: Genitive with adjectives, time and place

aula.titulo: The genitive: possession, time and wegen, während, trotz
aula.objetivo: Use the genitive for possession (das Auto meines Vaters), with proper names (Annas Auto), in expressions of time and place (Ende des Jahres), and after wegen, während and trotz.

sessao.titulo: Genitive with adjectives, time and place

blocos.explicacao: STEP 1: look at how the owner appears in the table: «Toms Auto», «das Haus des Mannes», «die Tasche meiner Mutter». STEP 2: which article marks the genitive of masculine and neuter nouns? And of feminine and plural? STEP 3: what happens to a masculine or neuter noun itself in the genitive? Does it remind you of English 's? STEP 4: now compare «der Tisch → des Tisches» with «der Student → des Studenten» and «der Nachbar → des Nachbarn». Where is the difference? Check your answers in the next blocks.

blocos.titulo: The genitive with adjectives and in expressions of time and place
blocos.explicacao: STEP 1: with an adjective, the ending is «-en» for all genders: «das Auto meines alten Vaters» (my old father's car), «die Tasche der netten Frau». STEP 2: the genitive appears in many EXPRESSIONS of time and place: «am Anfang des Jahres» (at the beginning of the year), «am Ende des Monats» (at the end of the month), «in der Mitte der Stadt» (in the middle of the city), «am Rand der Straße» (at the side of the road). STEP 3: with places: «die Hauptstadt des Landes» (the capital of the country), «die Größe des Zimmers» (the size of the room). STEP 4: «Name» and weak masculine nouns form the genitive with «-ns» and «-en»: «des Namens», «des Studenten».
